summary: Military aircraft, including fast jets, will carry out high energy manoeuvres within 15 nautical miles of Buckie, Monday to Thursday 12:00 to 20:00.
text:
MIL ACFT, INCLUDING FAST JETS, WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEVRES
WI 15NM RADIUS OF 574032N 0025744W (BUCKIE). ACFT MAY BE UNABLE
TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01343 817218. AR-2026-11232/01.
